input.rationale: Rear-end collision caused by another vehicle, resulting in a totaled car and injury to the policyholder; directly falls under auto coverage.

Totaled vehicle (exceeds $25k damage threshold) combined with injuries to the policyholder (whiplash and sprained wrist); this requires urgent adjuster attention and likely medical documentation review.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM. The at-fault vehicle was traveling ~35 mph with no braking; claimant's vehicle is totaled with structural damage from trunk to back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with at-fault driver's insurance information available.
